junkville/dog-captive.ask-about-gems: Why are gemstones worth so much, exactly?
junkville/dog-captive.ask-about-junkville-argument: So why hasn't Junkville just taken this place over, then?
junkville/dog-captive.ask-about-scavenging: What were you even looking for down here?
junkville/dog-captive.breakout: Alright. We're trusting you on this. Come on, everypony, this one's getting us out of here!
junkville/dog-captive.breakout-fail: Are you insane? They'll tear us apart before we make it ten steps!
junkville/dog-captive.dogs-slained: The diamond dogs are dead. You're free.
junkville/dog-captive.gems-value: You're a bit slow, aren't you? Gems aren't just pretty rocks. In the Crystal wasteland, half the old-world tech still kicking around, the stuff that still actually works, runs on charged crystals instead of batteries. Find the right vein, and you're sitting on something worth more than anything else you'd scavenge in your entire life.
junkville/dog-captive.junkville-argument: The folks from Junkville don't go into the caverns. Junkville scrapes by on rust and leftovers, and they have no idea just how much wealth they're sitting on. Meanwhile, the dogs are just chilling down there. It wouldn't take much to push them out and mine this place properly. Considering how they behave with ponies, I'd say we'd be well within our right to take over.
junkville/dog-captive.junkville-mission: You... you're here for us? I knew Randy wouldn't just let us disappear. So, what's the plan?
junkville/dog-captive.leave: Alright. I'll see what I can do.
junkville/dog-captive.leave-sarcastic: Wow. Must be nice, being the one who gets to walk away. Have fun out there.
junkville/dog-captive.let-them-rot: So that's what you'd do to them, given half a chance. Good to know. Enjoy the pen.
junkville/dog-captive.let-them-rot-alt: Good to know where your priorities are. I need to think this over.
junkville/dog-captive.missioned-by-junkville: I see. Well, I've got good news: Randy sent me to find you.
junkville/dog-captive.released: Wait, really? That's… thank you! Thank you! Come on, everypony, we're leaving!
junkville/dog-captive.scavenging: Scrap, mostly. Wire, circuits, old-world parts we could flip in Junkville. But when we found the entrance to underground tunnels, we started believing the rumors about this place being a gemstone mine, before the war. So we checked it out to see if we'd hit the jackpot. And it is packed with gemstones indeed. Unfortunately, it's also packed with diamond dogs.
junkville/dog-captive.situation: We all ended up down here, looking for scrap, or hoping for gemstones. The dogs found us and have been holding us here ever since then. They don't seem too sure about what to do with us. They wanted to know if we were with "the others". Don't really know what that's about, but apparently we at least convinced them that we didn't even know who they were talking about. We didn't do anything to them, I swear it.
junkville/dog-captive.suggest-breakout: I'm getting you all out of here. Follow my lead.
junkville/dog-captive.tell-freedom: I've spoken with your leader. You're free to go.
